description: This source file defines custom Cypress commands used for automated testing of the OrangeHRM web application. The commands facilitate actions such as login, API login, element retrieval, toast notifications, input setting, validation, and option selection within the test suite.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login operation by visiting the login page and submitting username and password.

methods.name: loginTo
methods.description: Performs login and navigates to a specified URL with optional parameters.

methods.name: apiLogin
methods.description: Performs an API login request with provided credentials.

methods.name: getOXD
methods.description: Retrieves an element from the OXD_ELEMENTS collection based on type.

methods.name: getOXDInput
methods.description: Finds an input element associated with a given label within OXD input groups.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Checks for a toast notification of a specific type containing a message.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of an input or textarea element.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Verifies if an input element displays a specific validation message.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects an option from a dropdown element.

calls: cy.request({ method: 'POST', url: '/functional-testing/auth/validate', body: { username, password } })
